text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. We set another new record today, didn't we?
It feels like I'm getting faster and faster.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Yes, your growth has been magnificent.
It is truly the fruit of Your Highness's tireless efforts.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Your guidance seems to be
quite fitting as well, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Truly an incredible person...
That instructional ability is the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Since I began receiving your instruction,
my rate of growth has noticeably increased.
Your ability to identify weaknesses is remarkably sharp, too...

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
! Ha... While Her Highness's own efforts were certainly
the primary factor, I believe the Trainer's
contributions are quite commendable as well.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It was far more than just "tolerable."
Being able to channel my efforts properly was undoubtedly all thanks to her.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text: For Your Highness to say so much... We, too, must offer them our deepest gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I have to grow even more too.
I'm sure that will be the best way to repay everyone!
